data.name: ProfileNotFound
data.value: Profile not found. Open the Mini App and sign in.

data.name: ProfileUnavailable
data.value: The profile link is unavailable. Open the Mini App and sign in again.

data.name: WriteDisabled
data.value: Time logging through the agent is temporarily disabled.

data.name: ActionExpired
data.value: The confirmation period has expired. Prepare the time entry again.

data.name: ActionProcessed
data.value: This action has already been processed.

data.name: Indeterminate
data.value: The time entry result could not be determined. Check your time entries before trying again.

data.name: FutureDate
data.value: Time cannot be logged for a future date. Prepare the action with a valid date.

data.name: InvalidTimesheet
data.value: Unable to create the time entry. Check the date, duration, project, and comment.

data.name: Forbidden
data.value: You do not have permission to create the time entry.

data.name: ProjectNotFound
data.value: The project is no longer available. Prepare the time entry again.

data.name: ActionNotFound
data.value: The action was not found or is no longer available.

data.name: Conflict
data.value: The action has already been processed, has expired, or its result requires verification. Check your time entries before trying again.

data.name: BadRequest
data.value: Unable to perform the action because its data is invalid.

data.name: UnexpectedError
data.value: Unable to perform the action. Please try again later.
